units.rawText: The colors here are too vivid and everything here is just so orderly, nothing at all like Tartarus. I don't think I'll get used to not being able to set fires wherever I want either…

spans.text: The colors here are too vivid and everything here is just so orderly, nothing at all like Tartarus. I don't think I'll get used to not being able to set fires wherever I want either…

units.rawText: Still, I won't run away. I'm going to look this place in the eye and take it all in so I can figure out these memories and the feelings within them. However, I do need to flare off some of my flames... Off to the practice hall, then.
